1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) All prospective bidders are requested to go through the uploaded Additional Ter ms and Conditions (ATC) document very carefully. The Evaluation of Bids under Quality & Cost Based Selection (QCBS) will be don e strictly as per Part 3 of ATC. For work experience and financial turnover, bidders are requested to r efer the relevant clauses of Part 3 of ATC. Bidders are requested to refer the Minimum Eligibility Criteria in Part 3 of ATC for Pre-Qualification Criteria for bids. In case any bidder does n ot fulfill the Minimum Eligibility Criteria as per ATC, technical evaluatio n against each parameter for that bidder will be counted as zero. Work completion or experience certificates will be considered for online ap plication management in recruitment notification or similar services (as defined below) from the acceptable organizations (as defined below). Definition of Similar Services:- “Similar services” shall mean work experienc e in execution of services in any of the following areas: a. Online Application Management services for recruitment. b. Services involving calling, receiving, scrutiny and processing of online applic ations for recruitment. c. Development and implementation of customized online recruitment applicati on/software modules, including online application processing. d. Designing, development, hosting and management of customized web interfa ces/portals for candidates’ registration and online application management in r ecruitment. e. Any other work/service substantially corresponding to the Online Application

Management Services for recruitment. Acceptable Organizations for Work Experience or Work Completion Cer tificate: a. Any Government Department, or b. Any PSU, or c. Any public listed company or private company or Trusted having annual turn over of Rs.500 crore, subject to the same being issued from their Head office by a person of the company duly enclosing his authorisation by the management f or issuing such credentials. d. Work experience certificate from private individual shall not be accepted. GCC document of 2018 for Services in Railways is also attached in the tender bi d. Bidders are also requested to refer the latest provisions, if any, for GCC Servi ces. All prospective bidders are requested to check the GeM portal continuo usly for any updates regarding this bid. 5.
